models_evaluated: ML model trained on health system colonoscopy reports

links.outcome: Accuracy of automated process on local scanned reports against chart-review reference standard
links.effect: Accuracy 80.7% (557/690, 95% CI 77.8%-83.7%) for identifying presence or absence of valid follow-up date; false negative rate 32.9% (130/395).
links.quote: During process validation, the overall automated process achieved an accuracy of 80.7% (557/690, 95% CI 77.8%-83.7%) for correctly identifying the presence or absence of a valid follow-up date and a follow-up date false negative identification rate of 32.9% (130/395, 95% CI 29.4%-36.4%).

unlisted_practices: Automating extraction of follow-up dates from unstructured external reports into structured EHR fields using ML plus RPA

screen.reason: Empirical study describing the real-world deployment and evaluation of an ML and RPA pipeline to extract colonoscopy follow-up dates from external reports into the EHR.
